title: Listening Part 3 – dopasowanie (syntezator mowy)
intro: Pięć osób mówi o zajęciach sportowych. Dopasuj każdą do stwierdzenia A–H. Trzy stwierdzenia nie pasują do żadnej osoby.
script:
Speaker 1: I thought I'd hate it, because I'm not very sporty. But the first week was fun, and now I'm really improving. My coach says I have talent.

Speaker 2: I only took up the course to please my parents. They think it will help me get into a good university. Honestly, I'd prefer to spend my evenings with friends.

Speaker 3: I've been doing it for years, so I wanted to try something different. I'm learning from people with much more experience, and I'm enjoying the challenge.

Speaker 4: I signed up because my best friend did. We always go together, so it doesn't feel like hard work. I'm not sure I'd carry on without her.

Speaker 5: I'm doing it to lose weight before the summer. It's quite tiring, but I can already see a difference, and that keeps me going.

options: A. I was surprised by how much I liked it.
B. I'm doing it mainly because someone else wants me to.
C. I'm attending to improve my appearance.
D. I find it easier because I'm with a friend.
E. I'm happy to be learning from better players.
F. I'm too busy to do it regularly.
G. I wanted to challenge myself.
H. I think it's too expensive.
